spec.behavior: Read named meetings with RFC3339 timestamps carrying explicit numeric offsets, normalize them to UTC, sort by UTC instant, print each meeting's UTC RFC3339 form, UTC weekday, and minute gap from its predecessor, then print total span and meeting count.
